queries.rawSql:
with current as (
  select alarm_name as alertname,host,datasource as m_datasource,alarm_name as m_notif_plugin,plugin_instance as m_notif_plugin_instance,
        type as m_notif_type,DATE_TRUNC('hour',(alert_time)) as updated1, 1 as count
  from 
  (
    WITH labels AS (
  SELECT
    ai.rule_uid,
    ai.current_state,
    ai.labels_hash,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='grafana_folder'           THEN e->>1 END) AS sensor,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='host'                    THEN e->>1 END) AS host,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_notif_plugin'          THEN e->>1 END) AS alarm_name,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_notif_plugin_instance' THEN e->>1 END) AS plugin_instance,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_notif_type'            THEN e->>1 END) AS type,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_notif_type_instance'   THEN e->>1 END) AS type_instance,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_datasource'            THEN e->>1 END) AS datasource,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_currentvalue'          THEN e->>1 END) AS currentvalue,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='max_date_num'            THEN e->>1 END) AS max_date_num,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='status'                  THEN e->>1 END) AS last_status,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='notification_a'          THEN e->>1 END) AS notification_description,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='site_name_a'             THEN e->>1 END) AS site_name_from_alert,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_overlay'               THEN e->>1 END) AS m_overlay,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_iface'                 THEN e->>1 END) AS m_iface,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_notif_plugin'          THEN e->>1 END) AS atmp3_v  -- same as alarm_name for your CASE usage
  FROM alert_instance ai
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(ai.labels::jsonb) AS e
  WHERE lower(ai.current_state) NOT IN ('pending','normal')
  GROUP BY ai.rule_uid, ai.current_state, ai.labels_hash
),
active_silenced AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trim(both '"' from a.value::text) AS silenced_hash
  FROM maya_silence ms
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(ms.silenced_alerts::jsonb) a
  WHERE lower(ms.status::jsonb ->> 'state') = 'active'
),
last_anno AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.alert_id)
    a.alert_id,
    lower(a.prev_state) AS prev_state,
    lower(a.new_state)  AS new_state
  FROM annotation a
  ORDER BY a.alert_id, a.id DESC
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN lower(l.last_status) = 'failure' THEN 'Alerting'
    WHEN lower(l.last_status) = 'warning' THEN 'Warning'
    ELSE l.current_state
  END AS evaluate_status,
  l.last_status,
  ar.title,
  l.sensor,
  l.host,
  coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title) AS alarm_name,
  l.plugin_instance,
  l.type,
  l.type_instance,
  l.datasource,
  l.currentvalue,
  l.notification_description,
  l.site_name_from_alert,
  l.m_overlay,
  l.m_iface,
  -- keep your alarm_description CASE, replace atmp3.v -> l.atmp3_v, atmp7.v -> l.datasource
  case when coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='operational_status' then 'Control Plane Down'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_temperature' then 'System Interval Temperature'
                               when coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)= 'metric_absence'  then 'Monitoring agent down'
                               when coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)= 'sdnc_node_cpu'  then 'SDNC Node Cpu High'
                               when coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)= 'sdnc_node_ram'  then 'SDNC Node Memory High'
                               when coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)= 'sdnc_node_disk'  then 'SDNC Node Disk High'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_ifstatus' then 'Interface Down'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_bfd' then 'Data Plane Down'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='df' then 'High Disk Usage'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='cpu' then 'CPU Utilization Exceeded'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='alert_licence' then 'Alert Licence'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='memory' then 'RAM Utilization Exceeded'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_probe' and l.datasource='avg_delay' then 'Delay'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_probe' and l.datasource='jitter' then 'Jitter'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_probe' and l.datasource='loss_percentage' then 'Packet Loss'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_system_services' then 'Service Down'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_dhcp_relay' then 'DHCP Server Unreachable'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_dhcp' then 'DHCP Lease Pool Exhaustion'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_bgp' then 'BGP Peer Down'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='ntp_out_of_sync' then 'NTP Out of Sync'
                               else coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title) end alarm_description,
  trim(both '"' from (ar.annotations::jsonb->'alarm_id')::text) AS alarm_id,
  to_timestamp(ai.last_eval_time) AS time,
  to_timestamp(coalesce((l.max_date_num::double precision)/1e9, ai.current_state_since::double precision)) AS alert_time,
  round(extract(epoch from (now() - to_timestamp(coalesce((l.max_date_num::double precision)/1e9, ai.current_state_since::double precision))))/3600, 0) AS alert_time_since,
  CASE WHEN s.silenced_hash IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS silenced,
  CASE WHEN la.prev_state='alerting' AND la.new_state='normal' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS resolve_count,
  CASE WHEN lower(l.current_state)='alerting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS alarm_count,
  CASE WHEN lower(l.current_state)='nodata'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS nodata_count
FROM labels l
JOIN alert_instance ai
  ON ai.rule_uid = l.rule_uid AND ai.labels_hash = l.labels_hash
LEFT JOIN alert_rule ar ON ai.rule_uid = ar.uid
LEFT JOIN active_silenced s ON s.silenced_hash = l.labels_hash
LEFT JOIN last_anno la ON la.alert_id = ar.id
WHERE s.silenced_hash IS NULL

  )as q
  where  (site_name_from_alert is not null AND site_name_from_alert != '')
)


select updated, 
      count(*)+ (select case when DATE_TRUNC('hour',now())>updated then count(count) else 0 end  from current where  updated1<=updated ) as count
from( 
   select alertname,host,m_datasource,m_notif_plugin,m_notif_plugin_instance,m_notif_type, DATE_TRUNC('hour',now()) as updated,1 count 
  from current

  group by alertname,host,m_datasource,m_notif_plugin,m_notif_plugin_instance,m_notif_type,updated1 

)as q
group by updated
